title: Creek water and crayfish
caption:
Fifteen seconds of creek.

Most crayfish are active at night, and after moulting they often eat their old shell.

Source: U.S. National Park Service. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Sound-led water loop with almost no text; last shot returns to the first for a seamless loop. Note: clips are from Wolf Creek Falls Trail, USA; species not named beyond 'crayfish'.
